name: pugixml
reason: pugi::xml_document::load_buffer(const void*, size_t). Second on Debian dev installs (1,503 vs 2,676). Own DOM parser, no namespace processing (prefixes stay in names), so the namespace-aware control output would need adapter-side resolution. Not built in this one-parser pilot.

name: tinyxml2
reason: tinyxml2::XMLDocument::Parse(const char*, size_t). First on Homebrew install-on-request (1,757) but third on Debian dev installs (487). Own parser, not namespace-aware. Not built.

name: libxml++
reason: xmlpp::DomParser::parse_memory_raw(const unsigned char*, size_type). Lowest of the four on both metrics. C++ wrapper: parsing is done by the libxml2 C library, so it shares the libxml2 parser family with any libxml2 path. Not built.
